passages.text: And the word of the LORD came to me, saying, “Son of man, set your face against Gog of the land of Magog, the chief prince of Meshech and Tubal. Prophesy against him and declare that this is what the Lord GOD says: Behold, I am against you, O Gog, chief prince of Meshech and Tubal.
passages.sermon:
The LORD spoke to me.
He gave me a message.
He called me “Son of man.”
He told me to look toward Gog.
Gog rules the land of Magog.
Gog is the chief prince of Meshech and Tubal.
God told me to prophesy against Gog.
God told me to speak His words.
The Lord GOD says this:
“I am against you, Gog.
You are the chief prince of Meshech and Tubal.”
passages.original: וַיְהִ֥י דְבַר־ יְהוָ֖ה אֵלַ֥י לֵאמֹֽר׃ בֶּן־ אָדָ֗ם שִׂ֤ים פָּנֶ֙יךָ֙ אֶל־ גּוֹג֙ אֶ֣רֶץ הַמָּג֔וֹג נְשִׂ֕יא רֹ֖אשׁ מֶ֣שֶׁךְ וְתֻבָ֑ל וְהִנָּבֵ֖א עָלָֽיו׃ וְאָ֣מַרְתָּ֔ כֹּ֥ה אָמַ֖ר אֲדֹנָ֣י יְהוִ֑ה הִנְנִ֤י אֵלֶ֙יךָ֙ גּ֔וֹג נְשִׂ֕יא רֹ֖אשׁ מֶ֥שֶׁךְ וְתֻבָֽל׃

passages.text: I will turn you around, put hooks in your jaws, and bring you out with all your army—your horses, your horsemen in full armor, and a great company armed with shields and bucklers, all brandishing their swords.
passages.sermon:
The Lord speaks to Gog, the chief prince of Meshech and Tubal.
The Lord says, “I will turn you around.
I will put hooks in your jaws.
I will bring you out.
I will bring out all your army with you.
Your army includes horses and horsemen.
All your horsemen wear full armor.
A great company comes with you.
They carry shields and bucklers.
They all hold swords.”
passages.original: וְשׁ֣וֹבַבְתִּ֔יךָ וְנָתַתִּ֥י חַחִ֖ים בִּלְחָיֶ֑יךָ וְהוֹצֵאתִי֩ אוֹתְךָ֨ וְאֶת־ כָּל־ חֵילֶ֜ךָ סוּסִ֣ים וּפָרָשִׁ֗ים לְבֻשֵׁ֤י מִכְלוֹל֙ כֻּלָּ֔ם קָהָ֥ל רָב֙ צִנָּ֣ה וּמָגֵ֔ן תֹּפְשֵׂ֥י חֲרָב֖וֹת כֻּלָּֽם׃

passages.text: Persia, Cush, and Put will accompany them, all with shields and helmets, as well as Gomer with all its troops, and Beth-togarmah from the far north with all its troops—the many nations with you.
passages.sermon:
Persia will be with them.
Cush will be with them.
Put will be with them.
All of them will have shields.
All of them will have helmets.
Gomer will be with them.
All the troops of Gomer will be with them.
Beth-togarmah will come from the far north.
All the troops of Beth-togarmah will be with them.
Many nations will be with you.
passages.original: פָּרַ֛ס כּ֥וּשׁ וּפ֖וּט אִתָּ֑ם כֻּלָּ֖ם מָגֵ֥ן וְכוֹבָֽע׃ גֹּ֚מֶר וְכָל־ אֲגַפֶּ֔יהָ בֵּ֚ית תּֽוֹגַרְמָ֔ה יַרְכְּתֵ֥י צָפ֖וֹן וְאֶת־ כָּל־ אֲגַפָּ֑יו עַמִּ֥ים רַבִּ֖ים אִתָּֽךְ׃

passages.text: Get ready; prepare yourself, you and all your company gathered around you; you will be their guard.
passages.sermon:
God speaks to Gog, the leader of a great army.
God commands Gog to get ready.
God tells Gog to prepare himself.
Gog must also prepare all his company.
These people are gathered around Gog.
Gog will serve as their guard.
passages.original: הִכֹּן֙ וְהָכֵ֣ן לְךָ֔ אַתָּ֕ה וְכָל־ קְהָלֶ֖ךָ הַנִּקְהָלִ֣ים עָלֶ֑יךָ וְהָיִ֥יתָ לָהֶ֖ם לְמִשְׁמָֽר׃

passages.text: After a long time you will be summoned. In the latter years you will enter a land that has recovered from war, whose people were gathered from many nations to the mountains of Israel, which had long been desolate. They had been brought out from the nations, and all now dwell securely.
passages.sermon:
God speaks to Gog, a leader of a hostile nation.
God says you will be summoned after many days.
In the last years, you will come to a land.
This land has recovered from war.
The people in this land were gathered from many nations.
They live on the mountains of Israel.
These mountains were once always desolate.
God brought these people out from the nations.
Now all of them live there in safety.
passages.original: מִיָּמִ֣ים רַבִּים֮ תִּפָּקֵד֒ בְּאַחֲרִ֨ית הַשָּׁנִ֜ים תָּב֣וֹא׀ אֶל־ אֶ֣רֶץ׀ מְשׁוֹבֶ֣בֶת מֵחֶ֗רֶב מְקֻבֶּ֙צֶת֙ מֵעַמִּ֣ים רַבִּ֔ים עַ֚ל הָרֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל אֲשֶׁר־ הָי֥וּ לְחָרְבָּ֖ה תָּמִ֑יד וְהִיא֙ מֵעַמִּ֣ים הוּצָ֔אָה וְיָשְׁב֥וּ לָבֶ֖טַח כֻּלָּֽם׃

passages.text: You and all your troops, and many peoples with you will go up, advancing like a thunderstorm; you will be like a cloud covering the land.
passages.sermon:
You are a leader of a great army.
Many troops follow you.
Many nations join you.
You will go up against the land.
You will advance quickly, like a storm.
You will cover the land like a cloud.
Your army and the many peoples with you will fill the land.
passages.original: וְעָלִ֙יתָ֙ כַּשֹּׁאָ֣ה תָב֔וֹא כֶּעָנָ֛ן לְכַסּ֥וֹת הָאָ֖רֶץ תִּֽהְיֶ֑ה אַתָּה֙ וְכָל־ אֲגַפֶּ֔יךָ וְעַמִּ֥ים רַבִּ֖ים אוֹתָֽךְ׃ס

passages.text: This is what the Lord GOD says: On that day, thoughts will arise in your mind, and you will devise an evil plan.
passages.sermon:
The Lord GOD speaks.
He gives a message.
He addresses Gog.
He says, "On that day, something will happen in your heart."
You will have thoughts in your mind.
You will plan to do evil.
passages.original: כֹּ֥ה אָמַ֖ר אֲדֹנָ֣י יְהוִ֑ה וְהָיָ֣ה׀ בַּיּ֣וֹם הַה֗וּא יַעֲל֤וּ דְבָרִים֙ עַל־ לְבָבֶ֔ךָ וְחָשַׁבְתָּ֖ מַחֲשֶׁ֥בֶת רָעָֽה׃

passages.text: You will say, ‘I will go up against a land of unwalled villages; I will come against a tranquil people who dwell securely, all of them living without walls or bars or gates— in order to seize the spoil and carry off the plunder, to turn a hand against the desolate places now inhabited and against a people gathered from the nations, who have acquired livestock and possessions and who live at the center of the land.’
passages.sermon:
Gog is the subject.
Gog is an enemy leader.
Gog will say, “I will go up against a land of unwalled villages.”
Gog will come against a people who are tranquil.
These people dwell securely.
All of them live without walls.
They have no bars.
They have no gates.
Gog will come to seize spoil.
Gog will come to carry off plunder.
Gog will turn his hand against places that were once desolate but are now inhabited.
Gog will come against a people gathered from many nations.
These people have acquired livestock and possessions.
They live at the center of the land.
passages.original: וְאָמַרְתָּ֗ אֶֽעֱלֶה֙ עַל־ אֶ֣רֶץ פְּרָז֔וֹת אָבוֹא֙ הַשֹּׁ֣קְטִ֔ים יֹשְׁבֵ֖י לָבֶ֑טַח כֻּלָּ֗ם יֹֽשְׁבִים֙ בְּאֵ֣ין חוֹמָ֔ה וּבְרִ֥יחַ וּדְלָתַ֖יִם אֵ֥ין לָהֶֽם׃ לִשְׁלֹ֥ל שָׁלָ֖ל וְלָבֹ֣ז בַּ֑ז לְהָשִׁ֨יב יָדְךָ֜ עַל־ חֳרָב֣וֹת נוֹשָׁבֹ֗ת וְאֶל־ עַם֙ מְאֻסָּ֣ף מִגּוֹיִ֔ם עֹשֶׂה֙ מִקְנֶ֣ה וְקִנְיָ֔ן יֹשְׁבֵ֖י עַל־ טַבּ֥וּר הָאָֽרֶץ׃

passages.text: Sheba and Dedan and the merchants of Tarshish with all its villages will ask, ‘Have you come to capture the plunder? Have you assembled your hordes to carry away loot, to make off with silver and gold, to take cattle and goods, to seize great spoil?’
passages.sermon:
Sheba and Dedan are nations.
The merchants of Tarshish are traders from a distant land.
All the villages of Tarshish are included with these merchants.
These people will speak to you.
They will ask you a question.
They will say, “Have you come to take plunder?”
They will ask, “Have you gathered your people to carry away loot?”
They will say, “Do you want to take silver and gold?”
They will ask, “Do you want to take cattle and goods?”
They will say, “Have you come to seize a great amount of spoil?”
passages.original: שְׁבָ֡א וּ֠דְדָן וְסֹחֲרֵ֨י תַרְשִׁ֤ישׁ וְכָל־ כְּפִרֶ֙יהָ֙ יֹאמְר֣וּ לְךָ֔ הֲלִשְׁלֹ֤ל שָׁלָל֙ אַתָּ֣ה בָ֔א הֲלָבֹ֥ז בַּ֖ז הִקְהַ֣לְתָּ קְהָלֶ֑ךָ לָשֵׂ֣את׀ כֶּ֣סֶף וְזָהָ֗ב לָקַ֙חַת֙ מִקְנֶ֣ה וְקִנְיָ֔ן לִשְׁלֹ֖ל שָׁלָ֥ל גָּדֽוֹל׃ס

passages.text: Therefore prophesy, son of man, and tell Gog that this is what the Lord GOD says: On that day when My people Israel are dwelling securely, will you not take notice of this?
passages.sermon:
God spoke to Ezekiel.
God called Ezekiel "son of man."
God told Ezekiel to prophesy.
God told Ezekiel to speak to Gog.
God said, "This is what the Lord GOD says."
God said, "On that day, My people Israel will live in safety."
God said, "You, Gog, will see this."
God said, "You will notice when Israel lives securely."
passages.original: לָכֵן֙ הִנָּבֵ֣א בֶן־ אָדָ֔ם וְאָמַרְתָּ֣ לְג֔וֹג כֹּ֥ה אָמַ֖ר אֲדֹנָ֣י יְהוִ֑ה הֲל֣וֹא׀ בַּיּ֣וֹם הַה֗וּא בְּשֶׁ֨בֶת עַמִּ֧י יִשְׂרָאֵ֛ל לָבֶ֖טַח תֵּדָֽע׃

passages.text: And you will come from your place out of the far north—you and many peoples with you, all riding horses—a mighty horde, a huge army.
passages.sermon:
Gog is the leader from the far north.
Gog will come from his own land.
Many nations will come with Gog.
All these people will ride on horses.
They will form a large assembly.
They will be a powerful army.
passages.original: וּבָ֤אתָ מִמְּקֽוֹמְךָ֙ מִיַּרְכְּתֵ֣י צָפ֔וֹן אַתָּ֕ה וְעַמִּ֥ים רַבִּ֖ים אִתָּ֑ךְ רֹכְבֵ֤י סוּסִים֙ כֻּלָּ֔ם קָהָ֥ל גָּד֖וֹל וְחַ֥יִל רָֽב׃

passages.text: You will advance against My people Israel like a cloud covering the land. It will happen in the latter days, O Gog, that I will bring you against My land, so that the nations may know Me when I show Myself holy in you before their eyes.
passages.sermon:
Gog is a leader from the far north.
Gog will come against the people of Israel.
Gog will move like a cloud that covers the land.
This will happen in the last days.
God will bring Gog against His land.
God will do this so the nations will know Him.
God will show Himself as holy through Gog.
The nations will see this with their own eyes.
passages.original: וְעָלִ֙יתָ֙ עַל־ עַמִּ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל כֶּֽעָנָ֖ן לְכַסּ֣וֹת הָאָ֑רֶץ בְּאַחֲרִ֨ית הַיָּמִ֜ים תִּֽהְיֶ֗ה וַהֲבִאוֹתִ֙יךָ֙ עַל־ אַרְצִ֔י לְמַעַן֩ דַּ֨עַת הַגּוֹיִ֜ם אֹתִ֗י בְּהִקָּדְשִׁ֥י בְךָ֛ לְעֵינֵיהֶ֖ם גּֽוֹג׃ס

passages.text: This is what the Lord GOD says: Are you the one of whom I have spoken in former days through My servants, the prophets of Israel, who in those times prophesied for years that I would bring you against them?
passages.sermon:
The Lord GOD speaks.
He asks a question.
He addresses Gog, the enemy from the far north.
He says, “Are you the one I spoke about long ago?”
He spoke through His servants, the prophets of Israel.
These prophets lived in ancient times.
They prophesied for many years.
They said I would bring you, Gog, against My people Israel.
passages.original: כֹּֽה־ אָמַ֞ר אֲדֹנָ֣י יְהוִ֗ה הַֽאַתָּה־ ה֨וּא אֲשֶׁר־ דִּבַּ֜רְתִּי בְּיָמִ֣ים קַדְמוֹנִ֗ים בְּיַד֙ עֲבָדַי֙ נְבִיאֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל הַֽנִּבְּאִ֛ים בַּיָּמִ֥ים הָהֵ֖ם שָׁנִ֑ים לְהָבִ֥יא אֹתְךָ֖ עֲלֵיהֶֽם׃ס

passages.text: Now on that day when Gog comes against the land of Israel, declares the Lord GOD, My wrath will flare up.
passages.sermon:
The Lord GOD speaks.
Gog is an enemy leader.
Gog will come against the land of Israel.
This will happen on a certain day.
On that day, the Lord GOD will act.
The Lord GOD will become very angry.
His wrath will flare up.
passages.original: וְהָיָ֣ה׀ בַּיּ֣וֹם הַה֗וּא בְּי֨וֹם בּ֥וֹא גוֹג֙ עַל־ אַדְמַ֣ת יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל נְאֻ֖ם אֲדֹנָ֣י יְהוִ֑ה תַּעֲלֶ֥ה חֲמָתִ֖י בְּאַפִּֽי׃

passages.text: In My zeal and fiery rage I proclaim that on that day there will be a great earthquake in the land of Israel.
passages.sermon:
The Lord GOD speaks with zeal and fiery anger.
He makes a declaration.
He says this will happen on a certain day.
On that day, there will be a great earthquake.
This earthquake will happen in the land of Israel.
passages.original: וּבְקִנְאָתִ֥י בְאֵשׁ־ עֶבְרָתִ֖י דִּבַּ֑רְתִּי אִם־ לֹ֣א׀ בַּיּ֣וֹם הַה֗וּא יִֽהְיֶה֙ רַ֣עַשׁ גָּד֔וֹל עַ֖ל אַדְמַ֥ת יִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃

passages.text: The fish of the sea, the birds of the air, the beasts of the field, every creature that crawls upon the ground, and all mankind on the face of the earth will tremble at My presence. The mountains will be thrown down, the cliffs will collapse, and every wall will fall to the ground.
passages.sermon:
God is speaking.
God is powerful and holy.
God will show His presence.
All fish in the sea will tremble before God.
All birds in the sky will tremble before God.
All beasts in the field will tremble before God.
Every creature that crawls on the ground will tremble before God.
All people on the earth will tremble before God.
God will throw down the mountains.
God will make the cliffs collapse.
Every wall will fall to the ground.
passages.original: וְרָעֲשׁ֣וּ מִפָּנַ֡י דְּגֵ֣י הַיָּם֩ וְע֨וֹף הַשָּׁמַ֜יִם וְחַיַּ֣ת הַשָּׂדֶ֗ה וְכָל־ הָרֶ֙מֶשׂ֙ הָרֹמֵ֣שׂ עַל־ הָֽאֲדָמָ֔ה וְכֹל֙ הָֽאָדָ֔ם אֲשֶׁ֖ר עַל־ פְּנֵ֣י הָאֲדָמָ֑ה וְנֶהֶרְס֣וּ הֶהָרִ֗ים וְנָֽפְלוּ֙ הַמַּדְרֵג֔וֹת וְכָל־ חוֹמָ֖ה לָאָ֥רֶץ תִּפּֽוֹל׃

passages.text: And I will summon a sword against Gog on all My mountains, declares the Lord GOD, and every man’s sword will be against his brother.
passages.sermon:
The Lord GOD speaks.
He declares His will.
He will call for a sword against Gog.
He will do this on all His mountains.
Every man will turn his sword against his brother.
passages.original: וְקָרָ֨אתִי עָלָ֤יו לְכָל־ הָרַי֙ חֶ֔רֶב נְאֻ֖ם אֲדֹנָ֣י יְהוִ֑ה חֶ֥רֶב אִ֖ישׁ בְּאָחִ֥יו תִּֽהְיֶֽה׃

passages.text: I will execute judgment upon him with plague and bloodshed. I will pour out torrents of rain, hailstones, fire, and sulfur on him and on his troops and on the many nations with him.
passages.sermon:
God is the speaker.
God is powerful and judges the nations.
God will judge Gog.
God will punish Gog with plague.
God will punish Gog with bloodshed.
God will send heavy rain on Gog.
God will send hailstones on Gog.
God will send fire on Gog.
God will send sulfur on Gog.
God will pour these punishments on Gog.
God will pour these punishments on Gog’s troops.
God will pour these punishments on the many nations with Gog.
passages.original: וְנִשְׁפַּטְתִּ֥י אִתּ֖וֹ בְּדֶ֣בֶר וּבְדָ֑ם וְגֶ֣שֶׁם שׁוֹטֵף֩ וְאַבְנֵ֨י אֶלְגָּבִ֜ישׁ אֵ֣שׁ וְגָפְרִ֗ית אַמְטִ֤יר עָלָיו֙ וְעַל־ אֲגַפָּ֔יו וְעַל־ עַמִּ֥ים רַבִּ֖ים אֲשֶׁ֥ר אִתּֽוֹ׃

passages.text: I will magnify and sanctify Myself, and will reveal Myself in the sight of many nations. Then they will know that I am the LORD.
passages.sermon:
The Lord God speaks.
He says, “I will show My greatness.
I will make Myself holy.
I will reveal Myself to many nations.
Many nations will see Me.
They will know that I am the Lord.”
passages.original: וְהִתְגַּדִּלְתִּי֙ וְהִתְקַדִּשְׁתִּ֔י וְנ֣וֹדַעְתִּ֔י לְעֵינֵ֖י גּוֹיִ֣ם רַבִּ֑ים וְיָדְע֖וּ כִּֽי־ אֲנִ֥י יְהוָֽה׃ס
